queries: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), all_patients AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - a.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM patient_stats AS p CROSS JOIN all_patients AS a WHERE p.ratio > a.avg_ratio;

WITH patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), overall AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_averages) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - o.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE p.ratio > o.avg_ratio;

responses.sql: WITH patient_stats AS (SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic, AVG(HGB) / NULLIF(AVG(HCT), 0) AS ratio FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), all_patients AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM patient_stats) SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS avg_pic, AVG(p.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(p.ratio - a.avg_ratio) AS avg_excess_ratio FROM patient_stats AS p CROSS JOIN all_patients AS a WHERE p.ratio > a.avg_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: A ratio is undefined if a patient has no HGB or HCT values, or their average HCT is zero; undefined ratios are excluded from the all-patient average and comparison.

assumptions.assumption: A patient whose average HCT is zero has an undefined ratio and is excluded from the ratio averages.
